read.thesis: Q1 volumes strong (aggregates +14%, cement +10%) with mix-adjusted aggregate pricing +5%, but 2026 EBITDA guidance $8.1-8.5bn only reaffirmed and no capacity or capex disclosure; supply-side evidence thin.

triggers.label: Mix-adjusted aggregate pricing +5%
triggers.quote: On a mix-adjusted basis, our aggregate pricing was 5% ahead.

triggers.label: Aggregates volumes +14%, cement +10%
triggers.quote: Our aggregates volumes increased by 14% while pricing was 1% behind

triggers.label: 2026 EBITDA $8.1-8.5bn reaffirmed
triggers.quote: we expect full-year adjusted EBITDA to be between $8.1 and $8.5 billion

guidance.quote: we expect full-year adjusted EBITDA to be between $8.1 and $8.5 billion
diluted earnings per share between $5.6 and $6.5

guidance.value: Low single-digit volume growth, mid single-digit pricing

we would expect about $200 million of net incremental EBITDA contribution

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are pleased to reaffirm our financial guidance for 2026
